# UNO No Mercy Online

> Free, browser-based UNO No Mercy card game. Real-time multiplayer with friends or solo against AI opponents. No download, no account required.

Play now: https://uno-no-mercy.com/

## About

UNO No Mercy Online is an independent, fan-made web implementation of the No Mercy-style UNO card game. It runs entirely in the browser on desktop or mobile, with real-time multiplayer and single-player-vs-AI modes.

- Free to play
- No download or installation
- No account or registration required to play (guest play; an optional free account saves your stats)
- 2 to 10 players per game
- Works on mobile and desktop browsers
- Open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/alii13/Uno-no-mercy

## Implemented rules and cards

- Draw 6 and Draw 10 action cards
- Card stacking (draw cards stack onto each other, so a Draw 2 can grow into a much larger penalty)
- Skip Everyone
- Color Roulette
- Discard All (discard every card of one color at once)
- Number 7 hand swap (swap your entire hand with another player)
- Number 0 hand rotation (every player passes their hand around the table)
- 25-card Mercy Rule (a player holding 25 or more cards is eliminated from the game)
